2609.30005.title: VietPrism: A large-scale Vietnamese speech and deepfake corpus with diverse dialects and code-switching
2609.30005.paper_summary: Vietnamese speech research is constrained by resources that isolate automatic speech recognition from speaker, dialect, code-switching, and deepfake analysis. We introduce VietPrism, an open, multi-domain corpus that brings these dimensions together at scale: 993.4 hours and 403,941 bona fide utterances from 1,262 verified speakers across 8,388 real-world videos. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale Vietnamese corpus to jointly provide transcripts, consistent speaker identities, five dialect groups, and naturally occurring Vietnamese--English code-switching, which constitutes nearly half of the corpus by duration. We further create over 3.1K hours of spoof speech with four open-source and commercial synthesis systems. Every spoof is conditioned on a verified speaker reference and paired with a transcript- and speaker-matched bona fide utterance, enabling unique controlled evaluation with reduced lexical and identity confounds. Zero-shot evaluation of five pretrained multilingual detectors reveals striking brittleness: EER greatly varies across detector--generator pairings, while recent multilingual detector DFA-1B degrades from 16.3% to 33.6% as speaker similarity increases. Dialect-stratified results expose further model-dependent disparities. By unifying natural linguistic diversity with controlled spoof generation, VietPrism provides a challenging foundation for Vietnamese speech modeling and trustworthy audio-deepfake detection.
2609.30005.paper_summary_zh: 越南語語音研究受到資源的限制，使自動語音識別與說話者、方言、代碼切換和深度偽造分析隔離。我們介紹了VietPrism，一個開放的多領域語料庫，將這些維度在規模上結合在一起：來自1,262位經過驗證的說話者的993.4小時和403,941條真實語句，來自8,388個真實世界的視頻。據我們所知，它是第一個大規模的越南語語料庫，聯合提供轉錄文本、一致的說話者身份、五個方言組和自然發生的越南語-英語代碼切換，這幾乎佔據了語料庫一半的時長。我們進一步創建了超過3.1K小時的偽造語音，使用四個開源和商業合成系統。每個偽造語音都是基於經過驗證的說話者參考，並與轉錄文本和說話者匹配的真實語句配對，從而實現獨特的受控評估，減少詞彙和身份的混淆。對五個預訓練的多語言檢測器進行零樣本評估顯示出驚人的脆弱性：EER在檢測器-生成器配對之間變化很大，而最近的多語言檢測器DFA-1B在說話者相似性增加時，性能從16.3%降至33.6%。方言分層結果揭示了進一步依賴模型的差異。通過將自然語言多樣性與受控的偽造生成相結合，VietPrism為越南語語音建模和可信的音頻深度偽造檢測提供了一個具有挑戰性的基礎。
2609.30005.author: Minh Hoang et.al.
